_doc: Surface tags for art/palette.json colours (M2 Amendment B, D47). Every face painted with a tagged palette colour gets that kind's cartoon highlight in the toon shader (src/look/surfaces.rs reads this file); untagged colours are matte. specular: highlight strength; shininess: exponent (bigger = smaller, crisper blob); sheen: broad soft gloss under the blob; tint: how much the highlight takes the surface's own colour (metals). Keep colours distinct from every untagged palette colour (a test checks).
